description: Everything Aeroz holds about one shipment: profile and thresholds, status, items, custody events with their chip verification, the telemetry assessment (min/max/mean temperature, mean kinetic temperature, minutes out of range, peak shock, whether an excursion is open), the ranked routes, and open findings. Use for "where is it", "is the cold chain intact", "was it ever opened". An open excursion on a cold-chain lane means the load must be quarantined on arrival pending QA — say so.
name: shipment_status
